title: Craftables for Unobtainables
description: Craft many Items that you will not get normally like the Totem Of Undying, Diamond Horse Armor, Golden Apple, ect
body:
Ever wished you could craft those elusive items that seem locked behind RNG or rare structures? Craft Everything! is a Minecraft mod that unlocks crafting recipes for nearly every non-craftable item — with one exception: no Elytras, to keep end-game exploration meaningful.

This mod is perfect for survival players who want more control over item progression without removing all challenge. It adds balanced and lore-friendly crafting recipes for items like Saddles, Name Tags, Horse Armor, Totems of Undying, Enchanted Golden Apples, — but leaves Elytras and Nether Stars.

Features:

Adds recipes for almost all non-craftable items (except Elytra and Nether Star)

Keeps core game balance and progression intact

Custom recipes designed to feel fair and immersive

Lightweight and compatible with most other mods

Added new recipe for Leather Horse Armor You can also use existing one

Whether you're tired of the grind or just want more flexibility in crafting, Craft Everything! empowers your survival world without trivializing key game milestones.
